Strategy
The Fund mainly invests its assets into various types of exchange traded index funds (ETF) that invest their assets in both fixed income and stock markets. The Fund pursues a systematic rebalanced core-satellite investment strategy. The core investments consist of passive exchange traded market value weighted funds (ETFs), and the satellite investments of non-market-value weighted investment targets. The Fund’s investments are efficiently diversified both geographically and between various asset classes. The share of stock-based investments in the Fund’s investments may vary between 0 and 100 percent, the share of interest based investments in the Fund’s investments may vary between 0 and 100 percent and the share of other investments may vary between 0 and 100 percent. In a neutral market situation, the share of stockbased investments is 50 percent.
